description: This file provides utilities for bundling and managing inputs for TorchScript modules, including functions to create bundled inputs, inflate them, and augment models with such bundled inputs for testing and benchmarking purposes.

classes.name: InflatableArg
classes.description: A NamedTuple helper class for defining bundled inputs with optional custom inflation logic.

methods.name: torch.jit.ScriptModule bundle_inputs( model: torch.jit.ScriptModule, inputs: Sequence[tuple[Any, ...]] | dict[Callable, Sequence[tuple[Any, ...]] | None] | None, info: list[str] | dict[Callable, list[str]] | None = None, *, _receive_inflate_expr: list[str] | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of a ScriptModule with bundled inputs attached, supporting various input definitions and auxiliary functions.

methods.name: None augment_model_with_bundled_inputs( model: torch.jit.ScriptModule, inputs: Sequence[tuple[Any, ...]] | None = None, _receive_inflate_expr: list[str] | None = None, info: list[str] | None = None, skip_size_check=False, )
methods.description: Adds bundled sample inputs to a ScriptModule for its forward function, with support for custom input generators.

methods.name: None augment_many_model_functions_with_bundled_inputs( model: torch.jit.ScriptModule, inputs: dict[Callable, Sequence[tuple[Any, ...]] | None], _receive_inflate_expr: list[str] | None = None, info: dict[Callable, list[str]] | None = None, skip_size_check=False, )
methods.description: Adds bundled inputs for multiple functions or methods of a ScriptModule, enabling comprehensive testing.

methods.name: tuple[T|torch.Tensor,str,str|None] _inflate_expr( arg: T, ref: str, inflate_helper_fn_name: str, skip_size_check: bool = False )
methods.description: Determines how to inflate a bundled input argument, handling tensors with size optimization and custom inflation functions.

methods.name: tuple[list[str],list[str]] _get_bundled_inputs_attributes_and_methods(script_module: torch.jit.ScriptModule)
methods.description: Inspects a ScriptModule to gather existing bundled input attributes and helper methods for bundle management.

methods.name: str _get_inflate_helper_fn_name( arg_idx: int, input_idx: int, function_name: str, )
methods.description: Generates a standardized helper function name for inflating specific input arguments for a given function.

methods.name: bundle_randn(*size, dtype=None)
methods.description: Creates an InflatableArg wrapping a tensor that will be inflated with torch.randn.

methods.name: bundle_large_tensor(t)
methods.description: Wraps a tensor into an InflatableArg to allow flexible bundling regardless of size.
